title: Formatted JSON output
responsibility: Formats JSON-shaped data using the project’s tab-indented layout and short primitive-array style.

inputs.name: stableJson.value
inputs.description: JSON-shaped value to render; undefined object fields are omitted, while nullish values elsewhere become null.

outputs.name: stableJson
outputs.description: Formatted text with a trailing newline. Objects retain entry order; primitive arrays stay inline when they fit the 100-column layout calculation, otherwise values expand with tabs.
